question: A can do a piece of work in 10 days and B can do it in 15 days. In how many days can they complete the work working together?
explanation: A's 1-day work = 1/10. B's 1-day work = 1/15. Together they do (1/10 + 1/15) = 5/30 = 1/6 of the work in one day. Thus, together they will finish the work in 6 days.

question: [Company Target: Infosys/Accenture] A can do a piece of work in 22 days, and B can do the same work in 33 days. If they work together, in how many days will the work be completed?
explanation: A's 1-day rate = 1/22. B's 1-day rate = 1/33. Together, their combined 1-day rate = 1/22 + 1/33 = (22+33)/(22*33). Inverting this gives the total days: (22 * 33) / (22 + 33) = 13.2 days.
